up: Retrieve up to 1000 activity records where the standard relation equals '=' and the pChEMBL value is non-null for the human target CHEMBL1827 (cGMP-specific 3',5'-cyclic phosphodiesterase, a SINGLE PROTEIN target with tax_id 9606). Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pChEMBL value. Ensure the activities link to the correct target via target_dictionary and include compound structures for canonical SMILES. Filter for target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1827' and tax_id = 9606. Order results by molecule_chembl_id and assay_chembl_id.
sql:
WITH target_activities AS (
  SELECT a.activity_id,
         a.molecule_chembl_id,
         a.assay_id,
         a.pchembl_value,
         a.standard_type,
         a.standard_value,
         a.standard_units,
         a.standard_relation,
         td.tid,
         td.target_type,
         td.tax_id,
         td.pref_name,
         md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id
  FROM activities a
  JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
  JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
  JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molecule_chembl_id = md.chembl_id
  WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1827'
    AND td.tax_id = 9606
    AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
    AND a.standard_relation = '='
    AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
    AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
)
SELECT td.target_type,
       td.tax_id,
       md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
       md.pref_name AS canonical_smiles,
       a.pchembl_value,
       a.standard_type,
       ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id
FROM target_activities a
JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molecule_chembl_id = md.molregno
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
ORDER BY a.molecule_chembl_id, ass.chembl_id
LIMIT 1000
